description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Copy an existing event to set up a recurring show. Pass its eventId or use the selected event; optional attributes override copied values. Returns the clone API response or confirmation naming the source event.

attributes.description: Overrides for the clone (new name, dates, ...).

confirm.description: [REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL] Pass `true` to execute. This is a programmatic backstop to the description tag. Destructive tools also require your approval through the client.

eventId.description: Event ID to clone. Defaults to active event.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to replay a recorded successful request; use a new key for a different change.

name: clone_event

cloned_from.description: Source event identifier when the API returns no body.

result.description: The API result when it is a list, scalar or null rather than an object.

title: Clone event
